method: Copy and modify with a word list (after Timm 2014), fitted on public paragraph text only. For each word: with probability one quarter, take one of the last ten words written, at random, and change one glyph of it to another glyph drawn by glyph frequency; otherwise draw a word by frequency from the public word list. No word order, no meaning. 13,000 words, fixed seed, generated once; the one-quarter rate was set before generating and not tuned. On the practice split the near-copy share is 0.266 against the manuscript's 0.210. A plain glyph chain without any copying step (the text behind R-002) gives 0.120 and does not pass, so the fact does need a copying habit, but not a language.
